notes:
【实验版】改动较大，可能有未发现的问题。不想升级可以点更新卡片上的「稍后再说 / ✕」。
新增书签：点阅读页右上角的书签键，给当前页加一枚书签，再点一下取消；有书签的页右上角会垂下一条丝带。书签记的是那句话而不是页码，换字号、换排版之后仍在原处；正在朗读时，书签落在正在念的那一句上。
书签列表在「目录」面板的「书签」一栏：点一下跳过去（正在朗读就从那里接着念），删掉的可以撤销。
朗读服务有了标志：OpenRouter、Gemini、ElevenLabs、OpenAI、Azure、xAI、Mistral、Together、MiniMax、Fish Audio、硅基流动、火山引擎、阿里云百炼、智谱、阶跃星辰（图标来自 LobeHub Icons）。
「目录」面板第一次打开时也会滚到当前章。
notesEn:
[Experimental] Bigger changes; there may be undiscovered issues. To skip it, tap the X on the update card.
New: bookmarks. Tap the bookmark button at the top of the reader to mark the current page, and tap it again to remove it; a ribbon hangs from the corner of a bookmarked page. A bookmark remembers the sentence, not the page number, so it stays put when you change the font size or layout. While a book is being read aloud, it lands on the sentence being spoken.
Your bookmarks are listed under Bookmarks in the Contents panel: tap one to jump there (if the book is being read aloud, reading continues from there). Deleting one can be undone.
Speech services now show their logos: OpenRouter, Gemini, ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Azure, xAI, Mistral, Together, MiniMax, Fish Audio, SiliconFlow, Volcengine, Alibaba Bailian, Zhipu and StepFun (icons from LobeHub Icons).
The Contents panel now scrolls to the current chapter the first time it opens.
